components.html:
Does a rollback re-run the build?
No. A rollback repoints traffic at an artefact that already passed. It takes about four seconds.
Can two people deploy at once?
The queue is per environment. The second deploy waits, and the person who started it sees who is ahead of them.
What happens to in-flight requests?
The old revision keeps serving until it drains, up to 30 seconds. You can raise the limit per service.

components.name: segmented-control
components.title: Segmented control
components.description: A compact joined control for switching between a few views.
components.use: Changing the range or mode of the data already on screen.
components.avoid: Submitting a value in a form. It reads as navigation, not input.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: A labelled dropdown for one value from a known, short list.
components.use: Fewer than about a dozen fixed options, such as regions or environments.
components.avoid: Long or searchable lists. Use the combobox instead.

components.name: sidebar-nav
components.title: Sidebar nav
components.description: A vertical navigation list, optionally collapsed to an icon rail.
components.use: App shells with more than about five destinations.
components.avoid: Icon-only rails without labels or titles. Nobody can guess the icons.
components.html: Overview Deploys

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Grey blocks in the shape of the content that is loading.
components.use: A first load where you know the shape of what is coming. It reads faster than a spinner because the page does not jump.
components.avoid: Skeletons for an action a person just took. Use a busy state on the control they pressed.
components.note: skeleton-text shortens each following line so it reads as a paragraph. Mark the region aria-busy so it is announced.

components.name: sortable-table
components.title: Sortable table
components.description: A data table whose headers are buttons that re-sort the rows.
components.use: A table a person will scan by different columns: newest, slowest, largest.
components.avoid: Making every column sortable. Sort the columns people compare, not the ones they read.
components.note: aria-sort goes on the sorted th, and takes "ascending" or "descending". Sorting itself needs JavaScript.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner and skeleton
components.description: Indeterminate loading marks: a spinner for actions, a skeleton for content.
components.use: Spinner for a pending action; skeleton where content will land.
components.avoid: A full-page spinner when only one region is loading.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack and cluster
components.description: Vertical rhythm (stack) and horizontal grouping that wraps (cluster).
components.use: Almost every layout. These replace ad-hoc margins.
components.avoid: Hand-written margin utilities between siblings when a stack would do.
components.html: Stack spaces its children vertically; cluster groups them horizontally and wraps.

components.name: stat-card
components.title: Stat card
components.description: A single figure in its own frame, with an optional trend.
components.use: A number that needs more room than a stat strip gives it.
components.avoid: A grid of four identical stat cards at the top of every page. That is the decorative dashboard tell.

components.description: A spaced list for short related points.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.
components.use: Turning a behaviour on or off with no separate save step.
components.avoid: Fields inside a form that only apply after submit. Use a checkbox.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switching between views of the same object.
components.use: Two to six views that share one context.
components.avoid: Tabs for steps in a sequence. Use a stepper.
components.note: Show and hide panels, and move focus with the arrow keys, in application code. This markup is the visual shell.

components.name: tag
components.title: Tags and accent badges
components.description: Neutral tags and accent-coloured badges for categories rather than conditions.
components.use: Naming a team, region, or topic.
components.avoid: Encoding status with an accent colour. Use badge-status with data-state.
components.note: Accent badges name a category. A condition belongs in badge-status.

components.title: Terminal
components.description: A command and its output, with a labelled title bar.
components.use: Products driven by a CLI or config. Show a command you could really run.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text input that grows vertically.
components.use: Descriptions, notes, commit messages, and pasted payloads.
components.avoid: Single-line values. Use an input so the Enter key submits.

components.name: time-picker
components.title: Time picker
components.description: A native time input in the same framed field as the date picker.
components.use: Picking a time of day, usually beside a date picker in a scheduling row.
components.avoid: Using it for a duration. A duration is a number with a unit, not a clock time.

components.name: timeline

components.description: Events in order, each with a title, timestamp, and body.
components.use: Audit trails, incident history, and deploy logs.
components.avoid: Marketing roadmaps with invented dates.

components.name: toast-region
components.title: Toast region
components.description: The fixed corner container that stacks toasts.
components.use: One per page. Put every toast in it so they queue instead of overlapping.
components.avoid: Toasting an error a person must act on. A toast leaves. Use an alert or keep the error beside the control.
components.note: aria-live="polite" announces new toasts without cutting off the current sentence.

components.name: utility-layout
components.title: Layout utilities
components.description: Display mode, flex direction, alignment, and positioning.
components.use: Arranging the inside of a component the grids do not cover.
components.avoid: Recreating grid-split or cluster out of flex utilities. Use the named layout instead.

components.name: utility-responsive
components.title: Responsive utilities
components.description: Show or hide an element at a breakpoint.
components.use: Swapping a dense desktop control for a compact one on a phone.
components.avoid: Hiding a primary action on small screens. Move it or shorten it, but keep it reachable.

variants.description: hide at that breakpoint and below
show only at that breakpoint and below

components.note: hide-sm and show-sm act at the phone breakpoint; hide-md and show-md act at the tablet breakpoint.

components.name: utility-sizing
components.title: Sizing utilities
components.description: Width caps, full height, flexible growth, and overflow.
components.use: Capping a measure, letting one flex child take the remaining space, or scrolling a bounded region.
components.avoid: max-w on prose that already sits in a container or text-body. Both cap the measure for you.

variants.description: take the remaining space in a flex row
scroll or clip a bounded region

components.name: utility-spacing
components.title: Spacing utilities
components.description: Margin, padding, and gap on the shared space scale, from 1 to 8.
components.use: A one-off nudge that does not deserve a wrapper. Reach for stack, cluster, or a grid first.
components.avoid: Building a layout out of margin utilities. If you are setting three in a row, you wanted a stack.

variants.description: top margin, step 1 to 8 of the space scale
gap between flex or grid children

components.name: utility-surface
components.title: Surface utilities
components.description: Background, border, and corner rounding that match the framework tokens.
components.use: A small framed region inside a component, using the same tokens as the rest of the page.
components.avoid: Framing everything. Nested borders inside a panel are how a page starts to look like a stack of boxes.

variants.description: corner radius, from the geometry setting

components.name: utility-text
components.title: Text utilities
components.description: Alignment, semantic colour, and truncation for text.
components.use: Right-aligning a numeric column, tinting a status word, or clipping a long identifier to one line.
components.avoid: text-center on body copy. Left-aligned prose is easier to read, and centred blocks are a landing-page habit.

variants.description: clip to one line with an ellipsis
